notes:
Hotfix for v1.0.19 startup splash CORS bug.

### What broke in v1.0.19

The splash screen polled http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/status to detect when the sidecar was up, then redirected to the dashboard. The fetch ran from the Tauri webview's tauri://localhost origin into Flask at 127.0.0.1:5000 — cross-origin. Flask doesn't return Access-Control-Allow-Origin on its plain HTTP responses, so the browser CORS check rejected every fetch, the splash's catch block silently retried, and the redirect never fired. server.exe was running and serving traffic perfectly the whole time — the splash just couldn't tell.

### Fixed

Splash now uses fetch with mode 'no-cors'. The response is opaque (we can't read the body), but a successful TCP round-trip resolves the promise without a CORS check. ECONNREFUSED still throws so we keep polling correctly when the sidecar isn't yet listening. The redirect carries the webview to http://127.0.0.1:5000/ where every subsequent fetch is same-origin again and works normally.

### If you're still stuck on v1.0.19's splash right now

Wait ~5 minutes — v1.0.20 will auto-install on the hourly update tick, or you can right-click the tray icon → Quit, then relaunch and it picks up the new version on next launch. Your trading data is fine; server.exe stays running through the upgrade.
